tools.name: list_rental_options
tools.description: Lists every product id that can be rented, the most of each we have, the extras, and the rules (delivery, hours, minimum order, rush, discounts) that the price depends on.

tools.name: price_rental
tools.description: Works out the exact price of a rental, as the official quote would show it, with any free cheaper alternatives. Issues no quote and stores nothing.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Issues the official numbered TouristPads quote for a confirmed order and emails it with its PDF to the customer from info@touristpads.com. Returns the quote number, the total and the link where the customer confirms and pays.
